summary: Reads two packed scalar fields out of an entry of the container selected by a2 and writes them scaled to float output pointers. The byte field at byte-index a2+18 is scaled by 0.00390625 (1/256) into *a3; the signed 16-bit field at byte-index 2*a2+22 is scaled by 0.0099999998 (1/100) into *a4, and the raw 16-bit value is returned. Called per physics timestep from VehiclePhysicsTimeStep.

local_names.this: byte-addressable container of per-a2 packed scalar entries
local_names.a2: entry selector for the packed byte/short fields
local_names.a3: output pointer for the byte-sourced scaled value
local_names.a4: output pointer for the short-sourced scaled value
local_names.result: raw signed 16-bit value read from the short field

operations.description: Write *a3 = (double)this[a2 + 18] * scale, scaling the 8-bit field by 0.00390625 (1/256); the scale constant is a read-only float backed by a module global
Read a signed 16-bit value at byte-index 2*a2+22 and write *a4 = (double)result * scale, scaling by 0.0099999998 (1/100); the scale constant is a read-only float backed by a module global
Return the raw signed 16-bit value read from the short field; invoked each timestep by VehiclePhysicsTimeStep

unresolved: Which module global (flt_59E444 or flt_5AC988) backs which of the two scale constants (0.00390625 vs 0.0099999998) cannot be determined from this packet alone
The meaning of the a2 entry selector and what array the byte/short fields belong to is not documented
